gt_diagnostic_scope: Offline self-Otsu versus stored occupancy support only; no physical calls and no gate change.

definitions.nrmse: sqrt(mean((m-m_gt)^2)) / declared per-object amplitude from sealed contract
definitions.support: Stored high-resolution occupancy > .35; predicted foreground by 256-bin histogram Otsu
definitions.oracle: Best image NRMSE / any joint pass among sealed endpoints plus selected online incumbent; GT used only here. Joint-pass counts are known-pass lower bounds if physical residual coverage is incomplete.
definitions.visualization: Lowest online physical score among shared starts; all material panels use [.02,20].
definitions.independence: Object IDs cluster two layouts and five starts; grid/shape families are exposed, not population inference.
